title: CPF Module Schema: Azure DataFactory Pipeline module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-datafactorypipeline'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

activities_json.description: (Optional) A JSON object that contains the activities that will be associated with the Data Factory Pipeline.

annotations.description: (Optional) List of tags that can be used for describing the Data Factory Pipeline.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

concurrency.description: (Optional) The max number of concurrent runs for the Data Factory Pipeline. Must be between 1 and 50.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

data_factory_id.description: (Required) The Data Factory ID in which to associate the Pipeline with. Changing this forces a new resource.

description.description: (Optional) The description for the Data Factory Pipeline.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

folder.description: (Optional) The folder that this Pipeline is in. If not specified, the Pipeline will appear at the root level.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

moniter_metrics_after_duration.description: (Optional) The TimeSpan value after which an Azure Monitoring Metric is fired.

parameters.description: (Optional) A map of parameters to associate with the Data Factory Pipeline.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

variables.description: (Optional) A map of variables to associate with the Data Factory Pipeline.

id.description: The Resource ID of the azure data factory pipeline.

name.description: The Name of the azure data factory pipeline.

resource.description: The azure data factory pipeline resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Datafactorypipeline' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
